 Seungri /Photo=StarNews Seungri (36, real name Lee Seung-hyun), former member of the group BIGBANG, is set to become a father next January.
 According to a report by Grey News on the 26th, Seungri is expecting a child in January next year with his non-celebrity girlfriend in her 20s. The outlet also revealed that "the baby is a boy."
 The couple has currently secured a newlywed home in Gangnam, Seoul, and is reportedly planning to hold their wedding ceremony after the birth of the child.
 Meanwhile, Seungri debuted with BIGBANG in 2006 and gained significant popularity, but was designated as a key figure in the "Burning Sun Gate" scandal in 2019, leading to his departure from the team and expulsion from the entertainment industry. He was prosecuted on nine charges, including prostitution, procuring prostitution, violation of the Act on the Punishment of Sexual Violence, and habitual gambling, and received a confirmed sentence of one year and six months in prison from the Supreme Court in May 2022, which he served. He was released from prison in February 2023.
 In addition, Seungri was sued last August on charges of aggravated assault, aggravated intimidation, and aggravated false imprisonment. The charges stemmed from allegations that he assaulted a man in his 30s, identified as Mr. A, with whom he had been drinking at a restaurant in Gangnam-gu, Seoul. Seungri is currently denying the charges.
